description: This file contains utility functions for database schema management and data migration within the Superset project, including table creation/deletion, column and index management, foreign key handling, UUID assignment, and JSON data type conversions.

methods.name: get_table_column
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific column in a table.

methods.name: table_has_column
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: table_has_index
methods.description: Checks if a specific index exists in a table.

methods.name: assign_uuids
methods.description: Generates and assigns UUIDs to all rows in a table, using dialect-specific SQL if available.

methods.name: paginated_update
methods.description: Updates query results in batches, yielding each row and optionally printing progress.

methods.name: try_load_json
methods.description: Safely loads a JSON string into a dictionary, returning empty if input is None.

methods.name: has_table
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: drop_fks_for_table
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints from a table, optionally specific ones.

methods.name: create_table
methods.description: Creates a new table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: drop_table
methods.description: Drops a table if it exists, after removing foreign keys.

methods.name: batch_operation
methods.description: Performs a batch operation with progress logging.

methods.name: add_columns
methods.description: Adds new columns to an existing table, skipping existing columns.

methods.name: drop_columns
methods.description: Drops specified columns from a table, skipping non-existent ones.

methods.name: create_index
methods.description: Creates an index on specified columns if it does not already exist.

methods.name: drop_index
methods.description: Drops an index if it exists.

methods.name: create_fks_for_table
methods.description: Creates a foreign key constraint, handling SQLite limitations.

methods.name: cast_text_column_to_json
methods.description: Converts a text column to JSON type, with special handling for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: cast_json_column_to_text
methods.description: Converts a JSON column back to text type, with special handling for PostgreSQL.
